_readme: TEMPLATE ONLY — this file is ignored by the backend because it is not named labels.json.
Copy it to models/labels.json (or name it <model_stem>.labels.json) once you have filled in
the class names in the exact order your model was trained with. Order matters: index 0 of the
model output is mapped to the first entry, index 1 to the second, and so on.
2. a list of {label, gloss} objects       -> what you see below
`label` is the class name, `gloss` is the word the app speaks/writes.
If the number of entries does not match the model's output width the API still works
and reports the mismatch in /api/models and in each prediction's `warnings`.
